hook.name: ApexYieldHookV4
hook.description: Oracle-based swap hook that prices trades using Pyth and Chainlink feeds and executes them against an external vault (IApexVault) by returning a BeforeSwapDelta in beforeSwap. Applies zone-based dynamic fees, enforces vault liquidity checks, and includes an owner-triggered circuit breaker that halts swaps when oracle prices move too rapidly.
